description: This file implements a storage mechanism for geofence objects using Android's SharedPreferences. It provides methods to save, retrieve, and delete geofences identified by unique IDs, encapsulating the data as SimpleGeofence instances and managing their persistence lifecycle.

classes.name: SimpleGeofenceStore
classes.description: A class that manages the persistence of geofence data in SharedPreferences, allowing for storage, retrieval, and removal based on unique geofence IDs.

methods.name: SimpleGeofenceStore
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SharedPreferences instance with a given application context.

methods.name: getGeofence
methods.description: Retrieves a stored geofence by its ID, returning a SimpleGeofence object if all stored values are valid, or null otherwise.

methods.name: setGeofence
methods.description: Saves the properties of a given SimpleGeofence object into SharedPreferences under a specified ID.

methods.name: clearGeofence
methods.description: Removes all stored data associated with a specified geofence ID.

methods.name: getGeofenceFieldKey
methods.description: Constructs the key used in SharedPreferences for a specific geofence ID and field name.
